data.title: Josh Pook reviews GPT me, a terminal-based AI agen
data.content:
## Summary
Josh Pook reviews GPT me, a terminal-based AI agent capable of code execution, web browsing, and vision tasks. The video demonstrates the installation process, browser tool setup via Playwright, and the use of its local web UI to develop a Python game.

## Key Points
- GPT me is a terminal-based agent that can read, write, and patch local files.
- It supports web browsing using Playwright and Chromium to fetch real-time data.
- The tool includes vision capabilities for interpreting desktop screenshots and web pages.
- It features a Flask-based web UI and REST API for those who prefer a browser interface over the terminal.
- The agent is self-correcting, meaning it analyzes error outputs and attempts to fix its own code execution.

## AI Concepts
AI Agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), Self-correcting loops, Computer Vision, Multi-modal AI, Local LLM serving
